name: Yabu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yabu city emblem in green and blue: a green triangle with blue curved strokes, like a mountain and a river.
history: Municipal flag of Yabu, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 July 2004.

features.role: Yabu city emblem — a green triangle with blue curved strokes, like a mountain and a river
